8. INTERPRETATION / WHAT THIS DATA CAN AND CANNOT PROVE
========================================================================================================================
- This is substantially denser than a few representative frames: every integer frame, every unique key time, and every readable bone is included in the detailed report and the bone-sample CSV.
- Large motion/rotation rates locate transitions worth inspecting, but fast motion is not automatically a defect.
- The report can reveal timing, asymmetry, sudden transform changes, body bounds, approximate limb angles, root drift, and bone-length variation.
- It cannot reliably determine mesh intersections, clothing deformation, foot penetration, visual appeal, or whether the landing looks convincing without checking the actual posed character in the viewport/render.
- Use the timestamp/frame values from this report to navigate the timeline and decide which specific joints or phases to edit.
